meta.title: Lienholder & Lender Requests — Safe House Insurance
meta.desc: For banks, credit unions and leasing companies: request a declarations page, evidence of insurance, verification of coverage, or add your institution as lienholder. Safe House Insurance, El Paso TX.
meta.ogTitle: Lienholder & Lender Requests — Safe House Insurance
meta.ogDesc: Request a declarations page, evidence of insurance, or add your institution as lienholder.

hero.lede:
For banks, credit unions, leasing companies and dealer finance. Request a
        declarations page, evidence of insurance, verification of active coverage, or ask us to
        add your institution as lienholder on the policy.

form.h2: What do you need, and on whose policy?
form.sub:
Nothing is sent until you press the button at the bottom, and then it
        goes as an email from your own address.

dec.p:
Full policy summary — vehicles,
              drivers, coverages, limits, deductibles and dates.

eoi.p:
A certificate naming your
              institution, for the loan file.

add.p:
Add or correct your institution
              as lienholder or loss payee on the policy.

ver.p:
Confirmation that the
              policy is in force as of today.

loan.label: Your loan or account reference number
loan.help:
The number your institution files by. Documents sent without it
          are the ones that get lost on your side, not ours.

mail.label: Where should we send it?
mail.help: A work address at your institution.

phone.label: Callback number
phone.help: In case something on the policy does not match.

cname.label: Customer’s full name, as it appears on the loan

vin.label: Last 6 of the VIN
vin.help:
Six digits is enough to identify the vehicle. Please do not send
            the full VIN.

lname.label: Lienholder name, exactly as it must appear
lname.help:
Including ISAOA / ATIMA if your institution requires it. This is
            the line that gets a document rejected when it is wrong.

notes.label: Anything else
notes.ph: e.g. Coverage must show $500 comprehensive and collision deductibles or lower.

form.note:
This opens your email client with everything filled in, addressed to
        contact@safehouseins.com. Sending it from your own work address is what lets us verify
        the request.

done.lead:
Your email client should have opened with the details filled in. Press
        send there and it reaches our team. We answer lienholder requests the same business
        day, Monday to Friday, 11am–5pm Mountain.
done.warnHead: If your email client did not open
done.warn: Send the same details to contact@safehouseins.com, or call 915-503-1207. Please include your loan reference number either way — it is what we quote back in the subject line so the document lands in the right file on your side.

facts.agencyNote:
Independent agency licensed in Texas and New Mexico. We are the agent of record,
          not the carrier — the policy is issued by the insurance company named on the
          declarations page.
facts.phoneNote: Mon–Fri, 11am–5pm Mountain. This line does not receive text messages.
facts.emailNote:
Monitored during office hours. Put the loan reference number in the subject
          line.

c1.b: Send it from your institution’s domain
c1.p:
A declarations page lists a customer’s vehicles, drivers and home address. We
          release it to a lienholder with a recorded interest in the vehicle, and a request
          arriving from a work address at the institution named on it is the first thing that
          makes that verifiable. Requests from personal email accounts get a phone call
          before anything is sent.

c2.b: Give us the exact lienholder wording
c2.p:
"First National Bank" and "First National Bank ISAOA/ATIMA, PO Box 1234" are not
          the same line to a carrier, and the second one is what your own system will accept
          back. Nearly every rejected document we see is this and nothing else.

c3.b: Last six of the VIN, not the full one
c3.p:
Six digits identifies the vehicle unambiguously against a policy. There is no
          reason for a full VIN to travel by email for this, so we do not ask for one.

c4.p:
Driver license numbers, dates of birth, payment details and prior claim history do
          not go out with a lienholder request. If your underwriting genuinely requires
          something in that list, call us and we will work out the right way to handle it.

faq.q1: How quickly will we get it?
faq.a1:
Same business day for anything requested before 4pm Mountain, Monday to Friday.
          Adding a lienholder to a policy can take longer — the endorsement goes to the
          carrier and we send you confirmation once it is issued, usually 24 to 72 hours.
faq.q2: Can you add us as lienholder without the customer?
faq.a2:
Yes. Adding a lienholder or loss payee is a routine endorsement and does not need
          the customer to sign anything. We do notify them, because a change to their policy
          should never be a surprise.
faq.q3: The coverage does not meet our requirements.
faq.a3:
Tell us what the loan requires — deductible caps, minimum limits, comprehensive
          and collision both in force — and we will take it to the customer and to the
          carrier. That is faster than force-placing and it is cheaper for everybody.
faq.q4: Do you charge for any of this?
faq.a4:
No. Declarations pages, evidence of insurance, verifications and lienholder
          endorsements are part of servicing the policy.
faq.q5: Can we set up automatic renewal notices?
faq.a5:
Yes. Ask in the notes and we will add your institution to the policy so renewal
          documents go out to you each term without anyone having to ask.
faq.q6: We think the policy has cancelled.
faq.a6:
Send the request anyway and say so. We will tell you the actual status the same
          day, and if it has lapsed we will already be working on reinstating it before your
          force-placed notice goes out.

err.none: Tick at least one thing you need.
err.loan: We need your loan or account reference number — it is what the document gets filed against on your side.
err.who: Please give your name, so we know who to reply to.
err.mail: We need a working email address at your institution to send it to.
err.cname: We need the customer’s full name as it appears on the loan.
err.polVin: Give us either the policy number or the last six of the VIN — we need one of them to find the right policy.
err.vin: The VIN field takes the last six characters only.
err.add: To add your institution we need the lienholder name and mailing address exactly as they must appear on the policy.
